title: Preserve published machine responses when adding delivery operations
summary: The existing get, records, traverse and context machine operations retain the authored edge spelling shipped in 1.2.0 at both protocol versions. Version 1 records continue to omit per-record digest and snapshots continue to omit membership. Context envelope estimates describe the returned packet. A published 1.2.0 regression baseline protects these responses while protocol version 2 adds read, next and position.
